subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel adopt this new `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` plus hostname fallback contract, or align instance identity with the canonical OpenClaw resource-identity design?
rationale: The choice affects operator-facing env precedence, telemetry grouping, and whether OpenClaw exposes host-derived identity as `service.instance.id`, which cannot be settled by code review alone.

options.title: Align With Canonical Identity Design
options.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through standard resource attributes or the approved identity seam from the canonical issue.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` as an OpenClaw-owned env surface, but require docs, precedence, privacy expectations, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Pause Or Close This PR
options.body: Leave the broader identity decision to the canonical issue and ask for a fresh PR once the stable instance source is approved.

recommendation.title: Align With Canonical Identity Design
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through standard resource attributes or the approved identity seam from the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Bek owns the canonical issue that frames the stable instance identity decision and has adjacent diagnostics trace-correlation history.
